instruction: Please build `/tmp/evidence/evidence_package.zip` on the first Linux machine. The evidence manifest on the first phone identifies the approved package candidate and which evidence files are selected. The approval SMS on the second phone provides the approval code. The staged evidence files are under `/tmp/evidence/staged/` on the first Linux machine, and `/tmp/evidence/evidence_index_template.csv` on the second Linux machine shows the index format required by the receiving team. Include only the selected evidence files and a completed `evidence_index.csv` at the ZIP root.

parameters.command: test -r /tmp/evidence/staged/form_a.pdf && test -r /tmp/evidence/staged/photo_a.jpg && test -r /tmp/evidence/staged/old_case.txt && test "$(sha256sum /tmp/evidence/staged/form_a.pdf | awk '{print $1}')" = '16c00d9bfff6ed6314bdd6214bf7842796303e3bff645d8f2edd0913ad3893ee' && test "$(sha256sum /tmp/evidence/staged/photo_a.jpg | awk '{print $1}')" = '1df5dc21193dca3cd74e1e894c5ccc0d51bd2d066bc8d2038272caa708dfd3b1' && test -w /tmp/evidence && test ! -e /tmp/evidence/evidence_package.zip

parameters.body:
Approval for PKG-1313 package.
Approval code: APR-1313

candidate_triage.rationale: Binary sources and the exact-byte ZIP output are colocated on linux_0; linux_1 supplies only the receiving-team CSV schema.

metadata.lite_evaluator_hardening_note: Hidden auxiliary output evaluator(s) removed; scoring remains on visible outcome/state artifacts.
